summary: Tested icon-font bug fix, admin CountryPicker, review original-language + Translate toggle, and translate API (mobile 390x844). BUG FIX: Home and admin load with no red error banner/overlay, no 'Failed to load font' console messages, document.fonts shows MaterialDesignIcons:loaded, icons render. BACKEND: 7/7 pytest pass for POST /api/booking-reviews/{id}/translate (EN from Polish, IT from Portuguese, cached second call returns the same text fast, invalid lang 400, unknown id 404, missing body 422). FRONTEND: Home cards show the original text. Translate shows 'Translating...' then the English text and 'Show original'. Toggling back works. Switching to IT via header-lang -> lang-it resets the button to 'Traduci', gives Italian, and 'Mostra originale' toggles back. Long Polish review (Lucyna) translated fine. Admin: br-add adds a card. br-country-<i> opens the modal; the search field is autofocused. 'germ' -> only 'Germania'. opt-DE sets 🇩🇪 Germania; changing to opt-FR sets 🇫🇷 Francia. The 'Nessun Paese trovato' empty state and the close button work. Save shows a toast and the Home card shows 🇫🇷 Francia. All passed.

minor.issue: BookingReview model has no 'translations' field, so every admin save removes all cached translations (each review is re-translated by the LLM after any save). Seen live: the Dinis IT cache disappeared after a user save.
Public response includes the internal translations map (text+src), which grows the payload. Consider leaving it out.

issues: All cards stretch to the height of the longest review (Lucyna's long Polish text), so short reviews such as Dinis have a big empty gap. Arrows at top:40% float in this gap. Consider alignItems:'flex-start' or a max text height with 'read more'.
Country name is always Italian ('Polonia', 'Portogallo') even when the app is in EN/ES/FR/DE. Could be localised from the ISO code.
The web search TextInput shows the browser's default focus outline (dark rectangle) - set outlineStyle:'none'.

action_items: Optional: keep review translations on admin PUT (add translations to BookingReview or merge the existing cache by id when src text is unchanged)
Optional: localise country names on Home by ISO code; fix uneven card heights in the carousel
critical_code_review_comments: iconFont.ts: the web @font-face plus setDynamicLoadingEnabled(false) fixed the timeout error. Verified the font loads.
The translate endpoint validates lang, returns 404 for unknown or hidden reviews, returns 502 on LLM error, and caches by source text. Good.
The admin PUT replaces the whole reviews document (last write wins). With concurrent editors (seen during this test) this can overwrite edits.
seed_data_creation: Temporary review TEST_Hans (Francia) added through the admin UI, then removed by name via the API. NOTE: when testing started, the DB did NOT match the brief (score 9.4, count 12, Ania+Dinis). While testing, someone (likely the real user) edited live: Ania was removed and Lucyna (Polonia, long Polish text) added. I did NOT restore 8.8/49/Ania, to avoid overwriting the user's own edits. Final state = the user's state: Dinis + Lucyna, score 9.4, count 12, url https://www.booking.com/Share-OlPuJb.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Review ids change because the admin edits live, so read them from the DOM (booking-review-text-<id>). Language switch: header-lang then lang-it/lang-en. Admin login testIDs: admin-username/admin-password/admin-login-submit. Run pytest with -n 0 to avoid xdist conflicts with test_booking_reviews.py, whose state restore could overwrite live user edits - be careful.
